format: html

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(tidytext)
library(quanteda)
```

```{r}
circle_raw <- read_file("A07594__Circle_of_Commerce.txt")
free_trade_raw <- read_file("B14801__Free_Trade.txt")
a06785_raw <- read_file("A06785.txt")

raw_corpus <- tibble(
  doc_title = c("A07594__Circle_of_Commerce", "B14801__Free_Trade", "A06785"),
  text = c(circle_raw, free_trade_raw, a06785_raw)
)

glimpse(raw_corpus)
```

```{r}
cleaned_tokens <- raw_corpus %>%
  mutate(text = str_replace_all(text, "ſ", "s")) %>%
  unnest_tokens(word, text, to_lower = TRUE) %>%
  anti_join(stop_words, by = "word")
```

```{r}
sentiment_words_raw <- cleaned_tokens %>%
  filter(doc_title %in% c("A07594__Circle_of_Commerce", "B14801__Free_Trade")) %>%
  inner_join(get_sentiments("bing"), by = "word")
```

```{r}
raw_sentiment_summary <- sentiment_words_raw %>%
  group_by(doc_title, sentiment) %>%
  summarise(word_count = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = sentiment, values_from = word_count, values_fill = 0) %>%
  mutate(net_sentiment_raw = positive - negative)

print(raw_sentiment_summary)
```

```{r}

corpus_dfm <- cleaned_tokens %>%
  count(doc_title, word) %>%
  cast_dfm(document = doc_title, term = word, value = n)

corpus_tfidf <- dfm_tfidf(corpus_dfm)

tfidf_tidy <- convert(corpus_tfidf, to = "data.frame") %>%
  rename(doc_title = doc_id) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -doc_title,
    names_to = "word",
    values_to = "tfidf"
  ) %>%
  filter(tfidf > 0) %>%
  filter(doc_title %in% c("A07594__Circle_of_Commerce", "B14801__Free_Trade"))

sentiment_words_tfidf <- tfidf_tidy %>%
  inner_join(get_sentiments("bing"), by = "word")

top_sentiment_words <- sentiment_words_tfidf %>%
  group_by(doc_title, sentiment) %>%
  slice_max(tfidf, n = 5) %>%
  ungroup()

print(top_sentiment_words)

tfidf_sentiment_summary <- sentiment_words_tfidf %>%
  group_by(doc_title, sentiment) %>%
  summarise(total_tfidf = sum(tfidf), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = sentiment, values_from = total_tfidf, values_fill = 0) %>%
  mutate(net_sentiment_tfidf = positive - negative)

print(tfidf_sentiment_summary)
```

```{r}
final_sentiment_comparison <- raw_sentiment_summary %>%
  rename(
    raw_negative = negative,
    raw_positive = positive
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    tfidf_sentiment_summary %>%
      rename(
        tfidf_negative = negative,
        tfidf_positive = positive
      ),
    by = "doc_title"
  )

print(final_sentiment_comparison)

write_csv(final_sentiment_comparison, "final_sentiment_comparison.csv")
```

```{r}
tfidf_tidy <- convert(corpus_tfidf, to = "data.frame") %>%
  rename(doc_title = doc_id) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -doc_title,
    names_to = "word",
    values_to = "tfidf"
  ) %>%
  filter(tfidf > 0) %>%
  filter(doc_title %in% c("A07594__Circle_of_Commerce", "B14801__Free_Trade"))

head(tfidf_tidy, 10)
```

```{r}
sentiment_words_tfidf <- tfidf_tidy %>%
  inner_join(get_sentiments("bing"), by = "word")

top_sentiment_words <- sentiment_words_tfidf %>%
  group_by(doc_title, sentiment) %>%
  slice_max(order_by = tfidf, n = 5, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup()

print(top_sentiment_words, n = 20)
```

```{r}
tfidf_sentiment_summary <- sentiment_words_tfidf %>%
    group_by(doc_title, sentiment) %>%
  summarise(total_tfidf = sum(tfidf), .groups = "drop") %>%
   pivot_wider(
    names_from = sentiment, 
    values_from = total_tfidf, 
    values_fill = 0
  ) %>%
  mutate(net_sentiment_tfidf = positive - negative)

print(tfidf_sentiment_summary)
```

```{r}
final_sentiment_comparison <- raw_sentiment_summary %>%
  rename(
    raw_negative = negative,
    raw_positive = positive
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    tfidf_sentiment_summary %>%
      rename(
        tfidf_negative = negative,
        tfidf_positive = positive
      ),
    by = "doc_title"
  )

print(final_sentiment_comparison)

write_csv(final_sentiment_comparison, "final_sentiment_comparison.csv")
```
